from collections import deque
q=deque()
for i,row in enumerate(a):
 for j,v in enumerate(row):
  if v==2:q.append((i,j))
seen=set(q)
while q:
 i,j=q.popleft()

   seen.add((x,y));q.append((x,y))
for i,row in enumerate(a):
 print(' '.join('2' if v==0 and (i,j) in seen else str(v) for j,v in enumerate(row)))
print('changed',sum(1 for i,row in enumerate(a) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==0 and (i,j) in seen))
